material new Cork --base-color 0.7412 0.4157 0.3843 --no-slot

material assign Glass
add mesh cylinder --name Band --vertices 8 --radius 0.137 --depth 0.09 --location 0 0 0.1
material assign Oil
add mesh cylinder --name Neck --vertices 6 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.08 --location 0 0 0.26
material assign Glass
add mesh cylinder --name Cork --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.32
material assign Cork
select Jar Band Neck Cork
active Jar
join
select all
shade flat
export flask.glb
